method.workload: 49 total stones, 9 already placed, 40 remaining; same frozen state as preceding floor-map benchmark.
method.timing: One seed-0 search per profile in fresh sequential processes; search.search wall only; setup excluded; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
method.configuration: Exact snapshots of user-edited CPU/CUDA profiles, both requesting 512 iterations. No batch, worker, native CUDA capacity, root-candidate, or iteration overrides.
limitations: Single seed per profile; results are not averaged.
Root retention differs (CPU 12, CUDA 32), evaluation batch differs (12 vs 32), and backends can explore different trees. This compares configured profiles, not isolated hardware speed.
Evaluated nodes count includes failed physical evaluations and excludes the already-evaluated root. Iterations may revisit nodes.

cpu.yaml:
# Resolved from stacking-planner agent/configs/ablation.yml and Python defaults.
# Native-only controls and CLI override precedence: docs/excavator-planning.md.
units: si
tree:
  max_depth: 3
  iterations: 512
  max_search_time: 240.0
  max_children: 16
  root_max_children: 12
  exploration_constant: 2.0
  discount: 0.9
  failure_reward: -1.0
  simulation_depth: 5  # Legacy TREE_SIMULATION_DEPTH; absent from ablation.yml.
  initial_depth1_steps: 8  # Depth 1 until 8 objects have been placed.
  root_lookahead: true
widening:
  enabled: true
  coefficient: 3.0
  exponent: 0.5
generation:
  batch_size: 32
  expansion_retry_batches: 3
  min_feasible_children: 3
  attempt_multiplier: 3.0
  evaluation_batch_size: 12
  # Sample the unfilled active floor before higher placements at every depth.
  root_sampling_priority: lower_floor_first
  deeper_sampling_priority: lower_floor_first
validation:
  max_candidates: 8
  root_before_search: true
  rejected_root_retry_rounds: 3
  time_reserve: 30.0
  max_state_drift: 0.1
final_selection:
  mode: max_descendant
  max_weight: 1.0  # Legacy default for mode: max_descendant.
  validate_descendant_path: false
  validate_descendant_depth: 0
  require_validated_descendant: false
parallel:
  posegen_backend: cpu  # cpu or cuda
  simulation_backend: cpu  # cpu or cuda
  # Local native worker allocation; separate from legacy Ray resource settings.
  enabled: true
  workers: 12
root_cem:
  population: 96
  elite: 24
  iterations: 3
  keep: 12
  mutation_xy_std: 0.1
  mutation_yaw_std_degrees: 5.0
  fresh_fraction: 0.5
  duplicate_xy_threshold: 0.03
  duplicate_yaw_threshold_degrees: 5.0
  # Keep validation slots available for different stones.
  max_per_object: 2
  height_map_score_weight: 1.0
  seed: 0
bootstrap:
  mean_reward: 2.5
  horizon: 4
